car.name: Selfheal 2005
car.description: A plain long-wheelbase seven-seat 2005 US family minivan, kept alive into 2994. Basic 3.3 V6, four-speed automatic, removable rear benches and no roof rack. First Keys, not a sport trim.

catalogProvenance.referenceVehicle: 2005 US Dodge Grand Caravan SE long-wheelbase,3301cc OHV12V V6 gasoline,FWD4AT,seven seats with basic cloth second/third-row removable benches,15-inch steel wheel covers,no roof rack. Not short Caravan,SE Plus,Stow n Go,SXT3.8,C/V or Honda Odyssey.
